newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar falls as quota sugar enters market.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar falls as quota sugar enters market.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Thursday extended losses after the government began releasing additional stocks under the free sale quota system, dealers said.
Fresh consumer buying remained sluggish at the higher level while improved supplies dragged prices lower.
In ready delivery sugar S-30 slid by five rupees at 1,410/1,435 rupees per quintal while sugar M-30 fell by the same margin at 1,440/1,480 rupees per quintal.

"The government has commenced the release of sugar out of the additional free sale quota of 50,000 tonnes announced for the current month which in turn improved arrivals and eased tight supply position," said Haresh Shah, a leading broker.
Sugar mill delivery also eased to 1,340/1,360 rupees per quintal from 1,350/1,370 rupees as outstation buying fell at the mill level.
